decided: At the archive's sign-off the AI shows the saved brief whole, then asks one question with exactly two answers, Sign off or Decline; on a decline that gave no reason, it asks for the reason in the user's own words.
alternatives: A third answer that postpones the decision, which would leave the archive neither stopped nor going on.
Show a summary of the brief instead of the whole text.
Accept a decline with no reason and record it blank.
why: The user decides from the brief alone, so it is shown as written; two answers match the two outcomes the hold knows, and a decline must carry the reason so the next attempt can fix what the user named.
detail: SIGNOFF_HOLD_STEP in src/core/templates/workflows/archive-change.ts, interpolated into the archive (Step 3.7) and bulk-archive bodies.
